exercises.question: Which sentence expresses purpose?
options: Estudiamos para mejorar nuestro español. [We study in order to improve our Spanish.]
Estudiamos porque tenemos tiempo. [We study because we have time.]
Estudiamos; por eso mejoramos. [We study; therefore we improve.]

exercises.english: We study in order to improve our Spanish.
We leave early every day so that there are no problems.

sentences: Primero, queremos mejorar el servicio. [First, we want to improve the service.]
Después, organizamos una reunión. [Then we organise a meeting.]
Finalmente, tomamos una decisión. [Finally, we make a decision.]

exercises.question: Which word means «objective»?
options: objetivo [objective]
resultado [result]
causa [cause]

exercises.sentence: El ___ del proyecto es mejorar el transporte.
exercises.english: The objective of the project is to improve transport.
We work to achieve a good result.

options: We study in order to improve our Spanish.
We study because our Spanish is already perfect.
We study, so our Spanish was improved yesterday.

exercises.sentence: Salimos temprano todos los días para que no haya problemas.
options: We leave early every day so that there are no problems.
We leave late every day because there are no problems.
We leave early every day despite the problems.

exercises.sentence: Trabajamos para lograr un buen resultado.
exercises.english: We worked to achieve a good result.

options: Para mejorar el servicio. [To improve the service.]
Porque mejorar el servicio. [Because to improve the service.]
Para mejoramos el servicio. [To we improve the service.]
El objetivo es lograr un buen resultado. [The objective is to achieve a good result.]
Es para que logramos un buen resultado. [It is so that we achieve a good result.]
El objetivo es que lograr un buen resultado. [The objective is that to achieve a good result.]
Para que no haya problemas. [So that there are no problems.]
Para que no hay problemas. [So that there are no problems.]
Porque no haya problemas. [Because there are no problems.]

template.prompt: Say that we study to improve our Spanish.
Say that the objective of the project is to improve transport.
template.answer: El objetivo del proyecto es mejorar el transporte.

template.prompt: Say that we organise the meeting so that everyone can participate (use para que).
template.answer: Organizamos la reunión para que todos puedan participar.
